dimensions.query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM entity_profiles p, json_tree(p.longform) t
                  WHERE json_valid(p.longform) AND t.key='by' AND t.atom IS NOT NULL
                    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_tree(p.longform) r
                                WHERE r.path = t.path AND r.key='ref'
                                  AND (instr(r.atom,'Предисловие') > 0 OR instr(r.atom,'Введение') > 0
                                    OR instr(r.atom,'От издател') > 0 OR instr(r.atom,'Приложение') > 0))

SELECT b.id, b.speaker_slug, b.title, b.archive, b.year, b.note,
                  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM katha_tracks k WHERE k.album_id = b.id) AS n
             FROM katha_albums b ORDER BY b.sort, b.title

SELECT MAX(0, COUNT(*) - 21) AS n FROM entity_profiles p, json_tree(p.longform) t
                  WHERE json_valid(p.longform) AND t.key = 'ref'
                    AND t.path LIKE '%quotes%'
                    AND NOT EXISTS (
                      SELECT 1 FROM book_catalog b
                      WHERE b.readable = 1 AND instr(t.atom, substr(b.title, 1, 12)) > 0)
                    AND NOT EXISTS (
                      SELECT 1 FROM prayers pr
                      WHERE pr.name IS NOT NULL AND length(pr.name) > 8
                        AND instr(t.atom, substr(pr.name, 1, 10)) > 0)
                    AND NOT EXISTS (
                      SELECT 1 FROM entity_names n
                      WHERE length(n.value) > 8 AND instr(t.atom, n.value) > 0)

SELECT verse_id, purport FROM verse_texts WHERE coalesce(purport,'')<>'' AND (instr(purport,'а̄')>0 OR instr(purport,'н̣')>0 OR instr(purport,'ш́')>0 OR instr(purport,'х̣')>0 OR instr(purport,'м̇')>0 OR instr(purport,'т̣')>0 OR instr(purport,'р̣')>0 OR instr(purport,'ā')>0 OR instr(purport,'ṛ')>0 OR instr(purport,'йа')>0 OR instr(purport,'йо')>0 OR instr(purport,'кша')>0) ORDER BY verse_id LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

SELECT e.id AS slug,
            (SELECT n.value FROM entity_names n WHERE n.entity_id = e.id AND n.lang='ru' AND n.kind='canonical' LIMIT ?) AS name,
            e.tattva AS tattva,
            e.note AS note,
            ep.summary AS summary,
            (SELECT ec.category FROM entity_categories ec WHERE ec.entity_id = e.id AND (ec.category LIKE 'wave-%' OR ec.category LIKE 'rasa:%' OR ec.category LIKE 'bhag-%') LIMIT 1) AS sub,
            (SELECT ec.category FROM entity_categories ec WHERE ec.entity_id = e.id AND (ec.category LIKE 'w1-%' OR ec.category LIKE 'w2-%' OR ec.category LIKE 'ws-%' OR ec.category LIKE 'wi-%') LIMIT 1) AS grp,
            (SELECT ec.category FROM entity_categories ec WHERE ec.entity_id = e.id AND ec.category LIKE 'lila-%' LIMIT 1) AS lila,
            (SELECT ec.category FROM entity_categories ec WHERE ec.entity_id = e.id AND ec.category LIKE 'wave-%' LIMIT 1) AS wave,
            (SELECT ec.category FROM entity_categories ec WHERE ec.entity_id = e.id AND ec.category LIKE 'rasa:%' LIMIT 1) AS rasa,
            (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM json_tree(COALESCE(ep.longform, '{}')) WHERE key = 'byId') AS n_quotes
       FROM entities e
       LEFT JOIN entity_profiles ep ON ep.entity_id = e.id
      WHERE e.type = 'personality' AND e.status = 'published'
      ORDER BY name

WITH spine AS (
       SELECT v.ref, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY d.ordinal, v.ordinal) AS rn
       FROM verses v JOIN divisions d ON d.id = v.division_id
       WHERE v.work_id = ?
     ), cur AS (SELECT rn FROM spine WHERE ref = ?)
     SELECT
       (SELECT ref FROM spine WHERE rn = (SELECT rn FROM cur) - 1) AS prev,
       (SELECT ref FROM spine WHERE rn = (SELECT rn FROM cur) + 1) AS next

SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM (
                    SELECT DISTINCT p.entity_id AS ot,
                           json_extract(el.value, '$.id') AS k
                    FROM entity_profiles p,
                         json_tree(p.longform) j,
                         json_each(j.value) el
                    WHERE j.key = 'see' AND j.type = 'array'
                      AND json_extract(el.value, '$.id') IS NOT NULL) x
                  WHERE x.ot <> x.k
                    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM entities e
                                WHERE e.id = x.k AND e.type = 'personality')
                    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM entity_relations r
                                    WHERE (r.from_id = x.ot AND r.to_id = x.k)
                                       OR (r.from_id = x.k AND r.to_id = x.ot))
SELECT id, album_id, title, duration, sort FROM katha_tracks WHERE speaker_slug = ?1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM entity_profiles p, json_tree(p.longform) t
                  WHERE json_valid(p.longform) AND t.key='t' AND t.path LIKE '%quote%'
                    AND length(t.atom) > 80
                    AND substr(rtrim(t.atom), -1) NOT IN ('.','!','?','»','"',':',';','…',')',']','”','’')
                    AND instr(substr(t.atom, -25), char(772)) = 0
                    AND instr(substr(t.atom, -25), char(803)) = 0
                    AND instr(substr(t.atom, -25), char(775)) = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) c FROM katha_tracks
SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM verses WHERE coalesce(devanagari,'')<>''

SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM tirthas a JOIN tirthas b
                  ON a.cluster = b.cluster AND a.dhama_id = b.dhama_id AND a.id < b.id
                  AND lower(replace(replace(replace(a.name,'-',''),' ',''),'а','')) =
                      lower(replace(replace(replace(b.name,'-',''),' ',''),'а',''))

SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM entity_profiles p, json_tree(p.longform) t
                  WHERE json_valid(p.longform) AND t.atom IS NOT NULL
                    AND instr(t.atom, 'Личности, с которыми') > 0
                    AND instr(t.atom, 'в источниках') > 0

SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM verse_texts vt JOIN verses v ON v.id = vt.verse_id
                  WHERE COALESCE(v.translit,'') <> ''
                    AND length(COALESCE(vt.translation,'')) > 2500

SELECT p.entity_id, j.value FROM entity_profiles p, json_tree(p.longform) j WHERE j.key='p' AND (instr(j.value,'а̄')>0 OR instr(j.value,'н̣')>0 OR instr(j.value,'ш́')>0 OR instr(j.value,'х̣')>0 OR instr(j.value,'м̇')>0 OR instr(j.value,'т̣')>0 OR instr(j.value,'р̣')>0 OR instr(j.value,'ā')>0 OR instr(j.value,'ṛ')>0 OR instr(j.value,'йа')>0 OR instr(j.value,'йо')>0 OR instr(j.value,'кша')>0) ORDER BY p.entity_id LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM entity_profiles p, json_tree(p.longform) t
                  WHERE json_valid(p.longform) AND t.key='by'
                    AND t.atom IN ('vrindavana-dasa-thakura','krishnadasa-kaviraja',
                                   'lochana-dasa-thakura','rupa-goswami','sanatana-goswami',
                                   'jiva-goswami','raghunatha-das-goswami')
                    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_tree(p.longform) q
                                WHERE q.path = t.path AND q.key='t'
                                  AND (instr(q.atom,'Прабхупад') > 0 OR instr(q.atom,'ИСККОН') > 0
                                    OR instr(q.atom,'Бхактиведанта') > 0 OR instr(q.atom,'Бхактисиддханта') > 0))

SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM entity_profiles p, json_tree(p.longform) t
                  WHERE json_valid(p.longform) AND t.key='t'
                    AND t.path LIKE '%quote%' AND length(t.atom) > 1500

SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM sb_audio a
                  WHERE a.ref IS NOT NULL AND a.ref <> ''
                    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM verses v
                                    WHERE v.work_id = 'sb' AND v.ref = a.ref)

SELECT v.id, v.ref, v.devanagari, v.translit, vt.translation, vt.purport
         FROM verses v
         LEFT JOIN verse_texts vt ON vt.verse_id = v.id AND vt.edition_id = ?1
         WHERE v.work_id = ?2 AND v.division_id = ?3
         ORDER BY v.ordinal

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM prayer_verses pv
                          WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM prayers p WHERE p.slug = pv.slug))
                       + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM prayer_verses WHERE slug LIKE '/%')
                       AS n

SELECT t.id, t.speaker_slug, t.album_id, t.identifier, t.file, t.title, t.duration
             FROM katha_tracks t LEFT JOIN katha_albums b ON b.id = t.album_id
            ORDER BY COALESCE(b.sort, 9999), b.title, t.sort, t.file

SELECT d.id, d.parent_id, d.level, d.number,
            json_extract(d.title,'$.ru') AS title_ru,
            COUNT(v.id) AS verses
     FROM divisions d
     LEFT JOIN verses v ON v.division_id = d.id
     WHERE d.work_id = ?
     GROUP BY d.id
     ORDER BY d.ordinal
SELECT COUNT(*) c FROM katha_albums
SELECT id, title, archive, year, note, sort FROM katha_albums WHERE speaker_slug = ?1
